checkpoint_review: I have re-evaluated the checkpoints independently. I also confirm that the head features (arched rostrum, blowholes) are not clearly visible due to angle and water distortion, so 'Head is relatively short...' remains Missing. Dorsal knuckles, full body shape, baleen, and tail flukes are genuinely untestable due to framing/submersion. Skin mottling and callosities are clearly present and Checked. My initial assessment was correct on all verdicts.

However, comparing to Reference 2 (authenticity=3.00 with similar artifact profile), my initial score of 3.12 may be slightly inflated given the compression + boundary smearing combination. I will adjust downward to better align with the reference anchor.

Score remains unchanged from initial as it accurately reflects the severe species-level misalignment.
